scope: Read-only source/template audit. Baseline findings recorded before the final-release fixes; live HTTP/cache/build comparison belongs to the root audit.

founders.name: Yuya Nakamura
bio: 組み込みシステム、業務システム、モバイルアプリなど、複数領域のソフトウェア開発を経験。現在はKUMAKIKAIで、iPhone・iPad向けアプリの企画・開発・運営を行っています。
作るものの分野は特に決めていません。自分が使っていて不便に感じたことや、身近な人から聞いた困りごとをきっかけに、必要だと思ったものをアプリにしています。

founders.name: Yuya Nakamura
bio: Yuya Nakamura has experience in software development across embedded systems, business systems and mobile apps. At KUMAKIKAI, Yuya currently plans, develops and operates apps for iPhone and iPad.

Yuya does not limit app development to a particular field. Ideas come from things Yuya finds inconvenient in everyday use or from problems mentioned by people close to Yuya. Yuya turns those ideas into apps when there seems to be a need for them.

founders.name: Yuya Nakamura
bio: Yuya Nakamura hat Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung für eingebettete Systeme, betriebliche Anwendungen und mobile Apps. Heute umfasst die Arbeit bei KUMAKIKAI die Konzeption, Entwicklung und den Betrieb von Apps für iPhone und iPad.

Yuya legt sich bei der App-Entwicklung nicht auf ein bestimmtes Gebiet fest. Ideen entstehen aus Dingen, die im eigenen Alltag umständlich sind, oder aus Schwierigkeiten, von denen Menschen aus dem persönlichen Umfeld erzählen. Daraus werden Apps, die Yuya selbst für notwendig hält.

founders.name: Yuya Nakamura
bio: Yuya Nakamura possède une expérience du développement logiciel dans plusieurs domaines : systèmes embarqués, applications métier et apps mobiles. Son travail chez KUMAKIKAI porte aujourd’hui sur la conception, le développement et le fonctionnement d’apps pour iPhone et iPad.

Yuya ne se limite pas à un domaine particulier. Les idées viennent de difficultés rencontrées dans ses propres usages ou de problèmes dont parlent ses proches. Quand un outil lui semble nécessaire, Yuya en fait une app.

founders.name: Yuya Nakamura
bio: 임베디드 시스템, 업무 시스템, 모바일 앱 등 여러 분야에서 소프트웨어 개발을 경험했습니다. 현재 KUMAKIKAI에서 iPhone·iPad용 앱을 기획·개발·운영하고 있습니다.
만드는 앱의 분야를 따로 정해 두지는 않았습니다. 직접 사용하면서 불편했던 점이나 주변 사람들에게 들은 어려움을 계기로, 필요하다고 생각한 것을 앱으로 만듭니다.

founders.name: Yuya Nakamura
bio: 具備嵌入式系統、企業應用系統及行動 App 等多個領域的軟體開發經驗。目前在 KUMAKIKAI 規劃、開發及營運 iPhone・iPad App。
沒有特別限定開發的領域。從自己使用時感到不方便的地方，或身邊的人提到的困擾出發，把覺得需要的工具做成 App。

findings.finding: About SEO description still says Uni:Noteなどの開発背景 after the Founder-specific anecdotes were removed. Founder body itself is current in all six locales.
findings.runtimeImpact: Current Japanese meta description and OGP description reference a removed emphasis. This does not select an old template.
findings.recommendation: Delete only the obsolete phrase Uni:Noteなどの開発背景、 and synchronize generated JA About front matter; the root accepted this limited metadata correction.

findings.finding: Empty Information state exists in the initial HTML without hidden; CSS display:none suppresses it until its category hash is selected.
findings.runtimeImpact: Raw HTML or CSS-unaware extraction can include the empty phrase even in the default All view. Full-browser behavior must be verified independently.
findings.recommendation: Add native hidden semantics to initial empty state, retaining category-only visibility and existing visual design; the root assigned this correction.

findings.finding: Unused translation key store still equals App Storeで見る. No runtime layout reads the store key; official app-store-badge partial is the actual CTA.
findings.runtimeImpact: Not emitted as the former custom CTA. Not evidence of an old Product template.
findings.recommendation: No runtime correction needed for this unused key within the constrained release audit.

findings.finding: Old section and pagination URLs are compatibility entries. Section templates use the current global shell, noindex, and Products links; the ten static pagination files are minimal meta-refresh stubs.
findings.runtimeImpact: No duplicate Support/Privacy hub is promoted by Header, Footer, Home or Product. Old Markdown privacy index lists are not rendered by the current list branch.
findings.recommendation: Keep these URLs; do not remove them as stale templates.
